items.source: By default, the content of incoming JMS messages gets extracted before being passed into the target listener method, to let the target method operate on message content types such as String or byte array instead of the raw Message. Message type conversion is delegated to a Spring JMS MessageConverter. By default, a SimpleMessageConverter will be used. (If you do not want such automatic message conversion taking place, then be sure to set the MessageConverter to null.)
items.translation: 默认情况下，传入的 JMS 消息内容会在传递给目标监听器方法之前被提取出来，以便让目标方法操作如 String 或字节数组等消息内容类型，而不是原始的 `Message`。消息类型转换委托给 Spring JMS MessageConverter。默认情况下，将使用一个 SimpleMessageConverter。（如果您不希望发生这种自动消息转换，请确保将 MessageConverter 设置为 null。）

items.source: Note: The sending of response messages is only available when using the SessionAwareMessageListener entry point (typically through a Spring message listener container). Usage as standard JMS MessageListener does not support the generation of response messages.
items.translation: 注意： 发送响应消息仅在通过 Spring 消息监听器容器等方式使用SessionAwareMessageListener入口点时可用。作为标准 JMS MessageListener使用不支持生成响应消息。

items.source: If a target listener method returns a non-null object (typically of a message content type such as String or byte array), it will get wrapped in a JMS Message and sent to the response destination (either the JMS "reply-to" destination or a specified default destination).
items.translation: 如果目标监听器方法返回一个非空对象（通常为消息内容类型，如 String 或字节数组），该对象将被封装为 JMS Message 并发送到响应目的地（即 JMS“回复”目的地或指定的默认目的地）。

items.source: Find below some examples of method signatures compliant with this adapter class. This first example handles all Message types and gets passed the contents of each Message type as an argument. No Message will be sent back as all of these methods return void.
items.translation: 下面是一些符合此适配器类的方法签名示例。第一个示例处理所有 `Message` 类型，并将每种 `Message` 类型的内容作为参数传递。不会发送任何 `Message`，因为这些方法都返回 `void`。

items.source: The default implementation builds an array with the given message object as sole element. This means that the extracted message will always be passed into a single method argument, even if it is an array, with the target method having a corresponding single argument of the array's type declared.
items.translation: 默认实现会构建一个数组，其中仅包含给定的消息对象。这意味着提取出的消息将始终作为单个方法参数传递，即使它是一个数组，只要目标方法声明了对应数组类型的单个参数即可。

items.source:
If no explicit delegate object has been specified, listener
methods are expected to present on this adapter instance, that is,
on a custom subclass of this adapter, defining listener methods.
items.translation: 如果未显式指定委托对象，则预期监听器方法定义在此适配器实例上，即定义在此适配器的自定义子类上的监听器方法。

items.source:
Delegates the message to the target listener method, with appropriate
conversion of the message argument. If the target method returns a
non-null object, wrap in a JMS message and send it back.
items.translation: 将消息委派给目标监听器方法，并对消息参数进行适当的转换。如果目标方法返回非 null 对象，则将其包装为 JMS 消息并发送回去。

items.source:
The default implementation simply returns the configured
default listener method, if any.
items.translation: 默认实现仅返回配置的默认监听器方法（如果有）。

items.source:
This can be overridden to treat special message content such as arrays
differently, for example passing in each element of the message array
as distinct method argument.
items.translation: 这可以被重写，以特殊处理消息内容（例如数组），例如将消息数组的每个元素作为独立的方法参数传递。
